question_text: A 42-year-old male presents to your office with cellulitis on his leg secondary to a dog bite. You suspect that the causative agent is a small, facultatively anaerobic, Gram-negative rod sensitive to penicillin with clavulanate. When you ask the patient how the bite occurred, the patient explains that he had a fight with his wife earlier in the day. Frustrated with his wife, he yelled at the family pet, who bit him on the leg. Which of the following defense mechanisms was this patient employing at the time of his injury?
